visual.description: Horizontal bar chart on dark bg (#1A1824). Countries ranked by absolute $ loss, top to bottom: US, Japan, Germany, UK, Canada. US bar extends dramatically further than others in #D47FA6 accent. Each bar shows dollar range with ticker animation. US: $411B (with range note 1.56–2.28% GDP). Japan: $88B–$138B (RANGE shown, not just ceiling). Germany: $60B. UK: $50B. Canada: $21B. Source label bottom-right: 'RAND RR-1791, 2016'.

notes: Japan MUST show $88B–$138B range, not just $138B ceiling. US $411B is the high-end scenario. Ticker animation on dollar amounts.
